package personalteacher_test

import (
	"context"
	"sync"
	"testing"
	"time"

	"github.com/stretchr/testify/require"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/domain"
	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-teacher-agent/internal/usecase/personalteacher"
)

type fixedID string

func (id fixedID) NewID() string { return string(id) }

type fixedClock time.Time

func (clock fixedClock) Now() time.Time { return time.Time(clock) }

type memoryTeachers struct {
	mu    sync.Mutex
	byID  map[string]domain.PersonalTeacher
	souls map[string]domain.TeacherSoul
}

func (repository *memoryTeachers) Ensure(
	_ context.Context,
	teacher domain.PersonalTeacher,
	soul domain.TeacherSoul,
) (domain.PersonalTeacher, domain.TeacherSoul, error) {
	repository.mu.Lock()
	defer repository.mu.Unlock()
	if existing, ok := repository.byID[teacher.StudentID]; ok {
		return existing, repository.souls[teacher.StudentID], nil
	}
	repository.byID[teacher.StudentID] = teacher
	repository.souls[teacher.StudentID] = soul
	return teacher, soul, nil
}

func (repository *memoryTeachers) GetByStudentID(_ context.Context, studentID string) (domain.PersonalTeacher, error) {
	repository.mu.Lock()
	defer repository.mu.Unlock()
	teacher, ok := repository.byID[studentID]
	if !ok {
		return domain.PersonalTeacher{}, domain.ErrPersonalTeacherNotFound
	}
	return teacher, nil
}

func (repository *memoryTeachers) Update(_ context.Context, teacher domain.PersonalTeacher, expectedVersion int64) (domain.PersonalTeacher, error) {
	repository.mu.Lock()
	defer repository.mu.Unlock()
	current, ok := repository.byID[teacher.StudentID]
	if !ok {
		return domain.PersonalTeacher{}, domain.ErrPersonalTeacherNotFound
	}
	if current.Version != expectedVersion {
		return domain.PersonalTeacher{}, domain.ErrVersionConflict
	}
	repository.byID[teacher.StudentID] = teacher
	return teacher, nil
}

func (repository *memoryTeachers) GetSoulByStudentID(_ context.Context, studentID string) (domain.TeacherSoul, error) {
	repository.mu.Lock()
	defer repository.mu.Unlock()
	soul, ok := repository.souls[studentID]
	if !ok {
		return domain.TeacherSoul{}, domain.ErrTeacherSoulNotFound
	}
	return soul, nil
}

func (repository *memoryTeachers) UpdateSoul(
	_ context.Context,
	soul domain.TeacherSoul,
	expectedVersion int64,
) (domain.TeacherSoul, error) {
	repository.mu.Lock()
	defer repository.mu.Unlock()
	current, ok := repository.souls[soul.StudentID]
	if !ok {
		return domain.TeacherSoul{}, domain.ErrTeacherSoulNotFound
	}
	if current.Version != expectedVersion {
		return domain.TeacherSoul{}, domain.ErrVersionConflict
	}
	repository.souls[soul.StudentID] = soul
	return soul, nil
}

func TestEnsureIsIdempotentPerStudent(t *testing.T) {
	repository := &memoryTeachers{byID: map[string]domain.PersonalTeacher{}, souls: map[string]domain.TeacherSoul{}}
	uc := personalteacher.Ensure{
		Teachers: repository,
		IDs:      fixedID("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001"),
		Clock:    fixedClock(time.Date(2026, 8, 30, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)),
	}
	first, err := uc.Execute(context.Background(), "student-1")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	second, err := uc.Execute(context.Background(), "student-1")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, first, second)
	require.Len(t, repository.byID, 1)
	require.Len(t, repository.souls, 1)
}

func TestUpdateChangesOnlyProvidedFields(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 8, 30, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	teacher, err := domain.NewPersonalTeacher("00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001", "student-1", domain.DefaultPersonalTeacherSettings(), now)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	soul, err := domain.NewTeacherSoul(teacher.ID, teacher.StudentID, domain.DefaultTeacherSoulSettings(), now)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	repository := &memoryTeachers{
		byID:  map[string]domain.PersonalTeacher{"student-1": teacher},
		souls: map[string]domain.TeacherSoul{"student-1": soul},
	}
	uc := personalteacher.Update{Teachers: repository, Clock: fixedClock(now.Add(time.Minute))}
	language := "en"

	updated, err := uc.Execute(context.Background(), personalteacher.UpdateInput{
		StudentID:       "student-1",
		ExpectedVersion: 1,
		Language:        &language,
	})
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "en", updated.Language)
	require.Equal(t, domain.DefaultCommunication, updated.CommunicationStyle)
	require.Equal(t, int64(2), updated.Version)
}

func TestSoulIsStoredAndUpdatedIndependentlyForEachStudent(t *testing.T) {
	now := time.Date(2026, 8, 30, 10, 0, 0, 0, time.UTC)
	repository := &memoryTeachers{byID: map[string]domain.PersonalTeacher{}, souls: map[string]domain.TeacherSoul{}}
	firstEnsure := personalteacher.EnsureSoul{
		Teachers: repository, IDs: fixedID("00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001"), Clock: fixedClock(now),
	}
	secondEnsure := personalteacher.EnsureSoul{
		Teachers: repository, IDs: fixedID("00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002"), Clock: fixedClock(now),
	}
	first, err := firstEnsure.Execute(context.Background(), "student-1")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	second, err := secondEnsure.Execute(context.Background(), "student-2")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.NotEqual(t, first.PersonalTeacherID, second.PersonalTeacherID)

	displayName := "Ada"
	updated, err := (personalteacher.UpdateSoul{Teachers: repository, Clock: fixedClock(now.Add(time.Minute))}).Execute(
		context.Background(), personalteacher.UpdateSoulInput{
			StudentID: "student-1", ExpectedVersion: first.Version, DisplayName: &displayName,
		},
	)
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, "Ada", updated.DisplayName)
	unchanged, err := repository.GetSoulByStudentID(context.Background(), "student-2")
	require.NoError(t, err)
	require.Equal(t, domain.DefaultTeacherSoulDisplayName, unchanged.DisplayName)
}
